Loomwright Studio · Charter card mockup (phase 8 item 18a)

The crew charter card in Wright's Chat: short by default (who, can do, never does, limits, readiness), complete on request (every enforced line, the settings file and role.md, uncut), with its readiness check, its workspace question, its Ask / Change box and the new version it brings, and Settings → Workspaces. Every state in light and dark. Click through, use the keyboard, or force a view from the strip below or the URL hash. Nothing here talks to a real kernel.

idle
Theme
Keys: Tab walks the card in this order: Copy all text, Show full details, each readiness fix (Add, Choose workspace, Check again, Run the check again), the workspace question (its saved folders, Use this folder, Choose folder…, Clone it for me, Not now), the details blocks (each block's Show more and Copy, then its text, which scrolls with the arrow keys), Ask or change and Send, then Approve and Deny · Enter/Space presses a control, ↑↓ picks a saved folder · Esc hides a tooltip; pressed again, it closes the workspace question and returns focus to Choose workspace · ⏎ in Ask or change sends · Add puts its duty into Ask or change and moves focus there · Chat ⌘1, Settings ⌘6 (in a browser tab ⌘ switches tabs first; use ⌃1 and ⌃6). URL hash: #view=<view>&theme=<light|dark|system>.
